method: local commands only, no model request: `codex exec --help`, `codex features list` and `codex <--disable f ...> -c project_doc_max_bytes=0 features list` with an empty temporary CODEX_HOME, and the complete frozen exec argv with an empty CODEX_HOME (no auth.json), which reached the API without credentials and ended with 401 Missing bearer (no model call possible). Raw outputs: scratchpad rep/cliprobe.

stays_enabled.unified_exec: --disable unified_exec and -c features.unified_exec=false are accepted but `features list` still shows unified_exec true (as Opus B observed); recorded, does not block launch, A4.3 governs its events

project_doc_max_bytes: -c project_doc_max_bytes=0 accepted: no error and no unrecognized-setting notice
observations: With an empty CODEX_HOME, `codex login status` prints 'Not logged in' and an exec request carries no bearer (401 Missing bearer): no OS credential store fallback was used for an empty home. The A4.2 telemetry still has to establish this for a reconstructed worker home.

At startup the CLI writes runtime state into CODEX_HOME, including skills/.system/* (bundled system skills such as imagegen, openai-docs, skill-creator), sqlite state files and installation_id. They are inventoried and removed after every call (Isolation.finish). skill_search is disabled; whether bundled system skills reach the model context is not observable without a model call and is left to the telemetry evidence and council.
secret_auth_storage is a stable feature, enabled by default; it is not a tool feature and is not disabled by the frozen arguments. The telemetry check (auth read from CODEX_HOME) covers its effect.

A WebSockets to HTTPS fallback produces the error item 'Falling back from WebSockets to HTTPS transport. ...', which is not a frozen KNOWN_NOTICE: a live call that hits that fallback is classified uncertain under A4.3.
The CLI refuses to create PATH helper binaries when CODEX_HOME is under the system temp directory; live run directories should therefore live outside temp (default ~/.ozmap_rep/runs).

disabled_with_notice.code_mode_host: accepted and disabled (council round 1, item 8: every available disable option is used). With it disabled every exec emits the error item 'Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled...' (id, type, message), which is not a frozen KNOWN_NOTICE: A4.3 classifies every such call as uncertain until a prospective signed ruling defines the allowed feature state and the treatment of that notice. The notice exception is not broadened here.
